ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Scandals
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in recent fraud scandals in Minnesota, including the $9B fraud scandal involving Minnesota AG Ellison.
questions: What is the source of the money?
How is the money being laundered?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale money laundering scheme. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the scheme.
